meta.note: First build. Fixtures and factor scores researched from match reports up to 27 Sept 2026.

fixtures.summary: South Africa's spinners have beaten Australia's batting twice. The series is already won, so SA may rest players, which keeps Australia in it.

factors.name: Recent form
factors.note: SA won the 1st ODI by 67 runs and the 2nd by 32. Before the series, SA's last five ODIs were WWWLW and Australia's WWWWL.

factors.name: Head-to-head
factors.note: South Africa have won six bilateral ODI series in a row against Australia.

factors.name: Home conditions
factors.note: Early-season South African pitches and a home crowd. Day/night game.

factors.name: Spin matchup
factors.note: Australia have the worst record of any side against left-arm spin since the last World Cup. Markram, Maharaj and Fortuin took 5 for 179 in the 2nd ODI.

factors.name: Batting form
factors.note: Miller 142 off 93 and Bavuma 103 in the 2nd ODI, Breetzke a hundred in the 1st. Marsh and Head both made 84 for Australia.

factors.name: Bowling depth & injuries
factors.note: SA are without Rabada, Ngidi, Baartman and Maphaka (hamstrings). Edwards took 5-67 and Hazlewood 3-70 for Australia.

factors.name: Motivation & rotation
factors.note: Series decided. SA may rest players before the Tests; Australia are playing for pride.

fixtures.summary: India chased 296 with more than eight overs to spare in the opener. West Indies' openers can score, but Kuldeep took the game away from them.

factors.name: Recent form
factors.note: India won the 1st ODI by 8 wickets, chasing 296 in 41.4 overs.

factors.name: Head-to-head
factors.note: India have dominated bilateral ODIs against West Indies for more than a decade.

factors.name: Home conditions
factors.note: Home crowd and Indian pitches that suit India's spinners.

factors.name: Spin matchup
factors.note: Kuldeep Yadav took 4-40 and removed both West Indies openers in the 1st ODI.

factors.name: Batting form
factors.note: Kohli 139* off 88 and Gill 110. For West Indies, Greaves made 101 and Campbell 62 in a 135-run opening stand.

factors.name: Bowling depth & injuries
factors.note: No injury news for either side. West Indies' best bowling figures in the opener were Chase's 1-64.

factors.name: Motivation & rotation
factors.note: West Indies must win to keep the series alive.
